title: Harness AI for better business intelligence: What's new and how to apply it
description: Gemini in Looker has made the most complex data actions simple, letting you chat with your business data. The latest advancements in Google's business intelligence (BI) suite bring insights to your users and customers, and form the basis of your own data-driven applications. This session will show you how we are building the future of BI with AI at the center, and keeping our focus on an open ecosystem that enables you to bring all your important data and share it with your teams - all driven by generative AI.
